thoughts: The current TRIPTYCH layout is functional but lacks the high-stakes, analytical tension suggested by the 'Dossier' and 'Strategic Intervention' themes. To increase dwell time and conversion, I am migrating to a FORENSIC_GRID strategy. This layout treats the systemic problem as a case study, using technical border logic, mono-spaced data points, and a starker hierarchical contrast. I'm enhancing the center-alignment balance requested while ensuring the 'Solution' column acts as a definitive visual anchor (The Bridge) through a high-contrast color shift. This creates a psychological progression from 'Evidence' (Problem/Agitation) to 'Resolution' (Nectar).
